Water use figures come from NR-05 and NR-11; the tariff comes from NR-15.

Brightwater: 3,315 megalitres × 1,000 = 3,315,000 cubic metres.  
3,315,000 × 142.35 = 471,740,250 tenge = 471.74025 million tenge.

Millbrook: 2,806 megalitres × 1,000 = 2,806,000 cubic metres.  
2,806,000 × 142.35 = 399,? Wait calculation: 2,806,000 × 142.35 = 399,? 
2,806 × 142.35 = 399,? 142.35 × 2800 = 398,580; ×6 = 854.1; total 399,434.1 thousand tenge = 399.4341 million tenge.

Difference: 471.74025 − 399.4341 = 72.30615 million tenge.

ANSWER: Brightwater | 72.30615

Brightwater used 3,315 megalitres (NR-05), while Millbrook used 2,806 megalitres (NR-11). The difference was:

3,315 − 2,806 = 509 megalitres  
509 × 1,000 = 509,000 cubic metres (NR-15)  
509,000 × 142.35 = 72,456,150 tenge (NR-15)  
72,456,150 ÷ 1,000,000 = 72.45615 million tenge

ANSWER: Brightwater | 72.45615

Brightwater water use: 3,315 megalitres (NR-05).  
Millbrook water use: 2,806 megalitres (NR-11).  
Difference: 3,315 − 2,806 = 509 megalitres.  
Convert to cubic metres: 509 × 1,000 = 509,000 cubic metres (NR-15).  
Cost difference: 509,000 × 142.35 = 72,456,150 tenge.  
In million tenge: 72,456,150 ÷ 1,000,000 = 72.45615 million tenge.  
Therefore, Brightwater households paid more.

ANSWER: Brightwater | 72.45615

NR-05 and NR-11 provide water use: Brightwater used 3,315 megalitres and Millbrook used 2,806 megalitres. NR-15 gives the tariff as 142.35 tenge per cubic metre, and 1 megalitre equals 1,000 cubic metres.

Brightwater cost:
3,315 × 1,000 × 142.35 = 471,470,250 tenge

Millbrook cost:
2,806 × 1,000 × 142.35 = 399,434,100 tenge

Difference:
471,470,250 − 399,434,100 = 72,036,150 tenge
72,036,150 ÷ 1,000,000 = 72.03615 million tenge

ANSWER: Brightwater | 72.03615

NR-05 reports Brightwater household water use of 3,315 megalitres; NR-11 reports Millbrook use of 2,806 megalitres. NR-15 states 1 megalitre = 1,000 cubic metres and the 2025 tariff is 142.35 tenge per cubic metre.

Difference in use:
3,315 − 2,806 = 509 megalitres

Difference in cost:
509 × 1,000 × 142.35 = 72,456,150 tenge

Convert to million tenge:
72,456,150 ÷ 1,000,000 = 72.45615 million tenge

ANSWER: Brightwater | 72.45615
